result_summary: QUALIFIED calibration result. P&L-blind 3x3 sweep selects i10_c504 as the only volatility-gate passer: score 0.403 vs fixed-control 0.619, max annual bucket share 55.2% vs 98.0%, median vol dwell 3, zero label loss, causal parity. Primary i20_c504 narrowly fails at 60.8%; 504 sessions is the local calibration sweet spot. Joint volxtrend rule not promoted because selected trend dwell is 2 sessions/singletons 17.1%. Descriptive P&L is nonmonotonic (low/normal/elevated/high Sharpe 1.18/1.47/1.14/0.73); no alpha claim or Null C.
